name: SIGNAL 2027
short: A real crowd, a poster you can tap, and tickets with the fee shown up front.
long: The first screen is a real crowd facing the stage, with a live countdown to doors. The line-up is a still poster sized by billing: tap any name for its day, room and time, and add it to your weekend, which flags clashes as you build it. Tickets are four tiers with live totals and the booking fee shown before you pay.
proves: Loud, and still easy to use.
story: The loud one, rebuilt around the crowd. Everything on it helps someone decide to go: who is on, when, where, and what it costs.
